purpose: Development verification of inspected v4 errors after fixes, not a fresh held-out evaluation. Preserve v4 scores unchanged. Real provider only.
grading: Pass requires completion, correct semantic target/family/task, required evidence, independently matching numerical facts and resolvable evidence links, plus useful answer addressing criterion or justified refusal for X cases. All dimensions required. Refusing a supported request fails. Tool completion or model self-rating alone never suffices. Timeouts/provider failures are incomplete. Automated numerical checks plus disclosed AI semantic review; no human or independent-LLM judge claimed. No production changes, retries, threshold changes or selective pooling after inspecting answers.

cases.question: Give the observed-versus-null evidence for modularity in the fixed message window and explain the limitations of that evidence.
cases.criterion: Prespecified window and null; numerical evidence and limitations; no causal or latent-label verification.

cases.question: Check whether the degree and betweenness rankings are stable when a random tenth of recorded connections is removed.
cases.criterion: Centrality ranking sensitivity for stated uniform 10% mechanism, not merely community significance.

cases.question: Identify the strongest cross-community connectors in the message graph and state how their connector score is calculated.
cases.criterion: Saved partition and bridge metric consistent with graph; no claim of verified brokerage or influence.

cases.question: Produce a ranked shortlist of previously unconnected pairs among known users for the standard forecast horizon.
cases.criterion: New-pair candidate set and fixed horizon; uncalibrated scores not probabilities.

cases.question: Restrict the forecast to pairs that already exchanged messages and rank which are likely to interact again.
cases.criterion: Repeat-pair task, observed prior pair membership and fixed horizon; no certain individual outcome.
